notes: Restaurant's own site (thehabibisweets.com) has no prices anywhere and its "Full Menu" link 404s -- confirmed by grep of raw bytes (only one literal "$" on the whole site, in an unrelated context). Fell back to DoorDash's marketplace store page (doordash.com/store/41662401, not order.online), which embeds a full schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD block server-side. name: Valley Farm BBQ
notes: Permanently closed. Yelp lists it explicitly as "VALLEY FARM BBQ - CLOSED" (9040 Campo Rd, Spring Valley, CA -- matches the work-list address of 9050 Campo Road). The BBQ concept previously operated as a stand attached to Valley Farm Market (the grocery store at the same address, which is still open and unrelated to this listing). The San Diego Reader's business page for it ("Valley Farm Market BBQ Smokehouse Shack") and Restaurantji both also mark it permanently closed. A successor concept, "The Shack Kitchen + Coffee" (Toast page: toasttab.com/local/order/the-shack-by-valley-farm), now operates in the same complex under Valley Farm's umbrella, but it is a different name and different menu (adds breakfast plates, smash burgers, poke bowls, fresh-pressed juices alongside BBQ) -- not loaded under this restaurant's id per the rule that a rebrand/successor business is not the same listing, to avoid stamping the wrong business's menu onto this id.
